about: Ball-flight height bands per club category (docs/design/ball-flight-classification.md). A shot is Low below L, High above H, otherwise Mid, judged by the first method the shot can use: landing angle, then apex/carry, then absolute apex against a speed-matched reference (driver only). Height is relative to ball speed and club, never to handicap.
status: provisional: heuristic starting values from the reference data, not an industry standard; to be tuned against PinPoint capture data (spec §4)

methods.label: Apex/carry
methods.unit: ratio (apex and carry in the same units)
methods.note: Wedge ratios are less reliable for partial shots; classify full swings only.

methods.label: Apex against a speed-matched reference

driver.note: Linear between the LPGA and PGA Tour driver points (about 0.26 yd per mph). Extrapolate cautiously below 140 mph.

methods.note: Only when neither landing angle nor carry is available, and only for the driver (the only speed-matched reference).

sources.title: Optimal TrackMan numbers by swing speed

notes: Thresholds transcribed from ball-flight-classification.md §4 (Mark Liversedge, 10 Nov 2026).
Reference values assume flat landing, calm conditions and sea level.
The 2 iron and 7 wood in the spec's categories are not in the app's club vocabulary.
